##### Project general facts

Derby Heights by AMIS is a boutique residential building that offers a quieter kind of city living, with interiors curated as a spatial edit by Casamia. A design that balances simplicity, beauty and comfort creates a calm, contemporary urban retreat. The building rises above a basement and a ground floor to four residential floors and a rooftop, offering one-bedroom apartments with a study, one-and-a-half-bedroom apartments and two- and three-bedroom homes with open-plan layouts.

The rooftop is crowned by an infinity pool surrounded by elegant cabanas and a spacious deck that invites quiet reflection or lively gatherings. A fully equipped gym supports an active lifestyle, while an outdoor cinema offers relaxed evenings under the sky. A children's play area provides a safe space for the youngest residents, and dedicated wellness spaces offer tranquil moments of rest, with every amenity curated to blend leisure, comfort and understated sophistication.

Residences embrace open-plan layouts, natural finishes and floor-to-ceiling glazing that floods interiors with light while framing city views. Balconies extend living areas outdoors, and selected layouts include a study, a powder room and a utility area. Interiors are completed with modern finishing and high-quality materials, and kitchens come fully fitted with premium Miele and Bosch appliances. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is a prestigious district inspired by the vision of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum, bringing legacy and liveability together. The Meydan Racecourse, home of the Dubai World Cup, The Meydan Hotel and Meydan Golf sit close to calm residential streets, landscaped parklands, artisanal cafes and top-rated schools, offering city life without the strain and a strong sense of community.

Meydan Mall and the racecourse are a short drive away, while Dubai Hills Mall, Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Design District and Dubai International Financial Centre are easily reached. Al Khail Road, Al Meydan Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with Dubai International Airport, Burj Al Arab and Palm Jumeirah, and schools such as Repton and Kent College are nearby.

Meydan is a freehold area with strong appeal for professionals and families seeking a calm address close to Downtown Dubai. Boutique buildings with premium finishes are in limited supply in the district, supporting steady rental demand from tenants working in the city's main business hubs. A central position and established lifestyle offer underpin long-term value for owners and investors over time.
